title: Russia hits Kyiv's grid with 36 ballistic missiles as remains are found aboard a ship struck off Romania; spillover rung holds at 4
bottom_line: Spillover risk is unchanged at rung 4 (deadly or deliberate incident). That rung rests on October's drone strikes on merchant ships off Romania and Bulgaria. No new incident in Europe met our logging threshold. Overnight, Russia hit Kyiv's grid with 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles; Ukraine says it stopped only four missiles and lacks Patriot interceptors. Varna prosecutors found human remains aboard the Wine Trader, struck near Sulina on 15 October. A shooting in Kraków that killed six has no reported Russian link. The 30-day chance of a step up to rung 5 stays remote (5%).

ladder.rationale: Rung 4 rests on the deadly drone strikes on ships in Romanian and Bulgarian waters on 13, 15 and 23 October. No new incident was logged today. A step to rung 5 needs deliberate, sustained Russian military action against a NATO or EU state, and we see no sign of it.

developments.headline: Russia hits Kyiv's grid with 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones; four missiles intercepted
developments.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said Russia launched Iskander-M, Zircon, KN-23 and S-400 missiles and 172 drones overnight on 6–7 November, 137 of the drones jet-powered. It said four missiles and 149 drones were downed, with hits at 24 locations. Zelensky said substations linking the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants to Kyiv were struck. The Pivnichnyi bridge closed, and nine people were injured.
developments.russian_framing: Russia's defence ministry claimed a 'massive strike' (translated) on military-industrial, energy and transport targets in Kyiv. It named the Severny bridge and the Meridian plant, which it says makes Flamingo missiles.

developments.headline: Ukraine hits Oryol electronics plant with Neptune missiles; Saratov refinery reported on fire
developments.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said Neptune coastal missiles hit the Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol overnight into 7 November, causing a fire. It said the strike complicates production of missile components. Monitoring channels reported that the Saratov refinery was set ablaze. Governor Busargin reported damage to homes but did not mention the refinery, so both strikes stay at claimed.
developments.russian_framing: Russia's defence ministry claimed it downed 411 Ukrainian drones overnight over ten regions, Crimea and the Black and Azov Seas.

developments.headline: Human remains found aboard the Wine Trader, struck by a drone near Sulina on 15 October
developments.summary: Varna prosecutors said badly damaged human remains were found aboard the San Marino-flagged tanker during repairs in Bulgaria and ordered DNA tests. A Bulgarian law-enforcement source told AFP there were 'very probably six' (translated) bodies. Seven of its 12 crew had been missing. Digi24 counts at least nine ships hit off Romania and Bulgaria since early October, with 34 dead or missing.
developments.russian_framing: Russia's defence ministry claimed new strikes on dry-cargo ships east and south-east of Odesa that it said carried 'military property and dual-use goods' (translated).

developments.headline: Zelensky warns of Patriot interceptor shortage and cautions on a European–Russian security track before talks
developments.summary: Zelensky said Ukraine faces a 'significant shortage of interceptors for Patriots' (translated) and asked the US to speed up deliveries before winter and before renewed negotiations. He said Russia was preparing for trilateral talks with ballistic strikes. He also said discussing a European–Russian security infrastructure 'may be dangerous' (translated), and that ending the war and guarantees for Ukraine must come first.

developments.headline: Shooting in Kraków kills six; Polish officials call it terrorism and cite the suspect's far-right views
developments.summary: A 24-year-old Polish man opened fire on Kraków's Market Square on 7 November, killing six and injuring 15. Police later found three more bodies at his home. Interior Minister Kierwiński called it terrorism and said the suspect may have been fascinated by far-right ideologies. No official has raised a Russian link, so we have not logged it.
developments.russian_framing: Russia's embassy in Poland issued a comment on the shooting, citing Polish authorities and media.

categories.text: Ukraine says Neptune missiles hit the Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol. Monitoring channels report the Saratov refinery on fire. Both strikes are logged at claimed. Russia's defence ministry said it downed 411 drones overnight and 28 more by day.

Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones, mainly at Kyiv's grid; four missiles were intercepted. Substations serving the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants and the Pivnichnyi bridge were hit. Kyiv faces blackouts and water shortages.

Kyiv is preparing for trilateral talks with the US and Russia. Zelensky warned that a European–Russian security discussion could be dangerous. ICDS's Kristi Raik called the US plan to link Ukraine talks to European security a concession to Russia.
Six people were killed in a shooting in Kraków. Polish officials treat it as terrorism and cite the suspect's far-right views. No official has raised a Russian link, so we have not logged it.
Bulgarian prosecutors found human remains aboard the Wine Trader, struck near Sulina on 15 October (INC-2026-0103). Russia's defence ministry claimed two more strikes on dry-cargo ships off Odesa.
Zelensky said substations connecting the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants to Kyiv were struck. We have seen no IAEA statement yet on output cuts or lost lines.
Estonia's KAPO warned that nearly 400 young Estonians studying in Russia risk being recruited by intelligence services or sent to the front.
Finland is studying Ukrainian-style anti-tank obstacles for its Russian border. Zelensky asked the US to speed up Patriot interceptor deliveries and expects new European contributions to PURL.

changes.summary: Russian drones struck two chemical tankers near Sulina. The Yara J caught fire at anchor inside Romanian territorial waters with no casualties. The Wine Trader was hit just outside them, and seven crew went missing. On 7 November, Varna prosecutors said badly damaged human remains were found aboard it during repairs.

judgement.text:
We assess the 30-day spillover picture is unchanged. The Black Sea shipping campaign remains the most likely route to further deaths. Airspace remains the most frequent source of incidents: eight logged in 30 days against a baseline of 13 a month. Nothing in the window moves any pathway by 5 points.

The raid Zelensky warned of arrived overnight. Ukraine's General Staff counted 36 ballistic missiles, including Zircon and North Korean KN-23s, and 172 drones, 137 of them jet-powered. It said four missiles and 149 drones were downed. Zelensky said substations linking the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants to Kyiv were hit. Russia's defence ministry claimed military-industrial, energy and transport targets, including the Severny bridge. The main axis was Kyiv, not the south-west, and we found no reported crossing into Moldova, Romania or Poland. We hold airspace at highly unlikely (15%). We assess that the growing share of jet-powered drones shortens reaction times for Romanian and Moldovan air defences when raids are routed over Odesa.

The Varna find adds weight, not new risk. Bulgarian prosecutors said badly damaged remains were found aboard the Wine Trader, and a source told AFP there were probably six bodies. If DNA tests confirm this, the October campaign on the Danube approaches was deadlier than our database records. Russia's defence ministry again claimed strikes on dry-cargo ships off Odesa. We hold maritime at likely (70%).

On current evidence, the Kraków shooting is not a spillover event. Interior Minister Kierwiński called it terrorism and cited the suspect's far-right views, and no official has raised a Russian link. Reports that pro-Russian hackers targeted Italy's foreign minister reached us only as leads we could not open, so we have not logged them.

Zelensky said Russia was 'preparing for the trilateral talks by launching ballistic missiles' (translated). He warned that a European–Russian security discussion 'may be dangerous' (translated). On the ceasefire paradox, a deal would cut near-term airspace and maritime risk. A framework settled over Europe's head could weaken deterrence later.
judgement.change_my_mind: We would revise if a Russian drone or missile crosses into Moldova, Romania or Poland during a raid routed over Odesa or Vinnytsia, if an official links the Kraków attacker to Russia, or if the IAEA reports that Rivne or Khmelnytskyi lost off-site power.

forecast_updates.note: Zelensky says substations connecting the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi plants to Kyiv were struck on 6–7 November. We await an IAEA statement on output or lines.
Zelensky says Russia is preparing for 'the trilateral talks' with strikes, which signals that Kyiv expects the round to go ahead.

taiwan: The most direct impact is on the supply of Patriot interceptors. Zelensky said Ukraine stopped only four of 36 ballistic missiles and asked the US to speed up Patriot interceptor deliveries before winter. Ukraine's PAC-3 demand draws on the same constrained production that fills Taiwan's orders. If Washington prioritises Kyiv this winter, Taiwan's delivery queue could lengthen. Second, Ukraine's General Staff listed North Korean KN-23 missiles in the salvo. That shows the Russia–North Korea munitions pipeline is still active, which matters for deterrence in North-East Asia. Third, the raid shows that mass ballistic salvos can overwhelm thin missile defences around a capital's grid. That is a direct lesson for Taiwan's planning on grid hardening and dispersed generation.
